title: Penthouse May 1987 Norma Jean Billy Martin Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, May 1987, original $4.00 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: Norma Jean - cop, call girl, and political candidate; Billy Martin shoots his mouth off... again; Reagan's White House; Smokers' Rights.

Back cover: Carlton cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
